title: Chapter 276 Warning: The Black Dragon City Undead Army Is Coming
content:
Chapter 276 Warning: The Black Dragon City Undead Army Is Coming

Meeting Hall.

Wang Shuo called Chang Gui, Zou Yuanjie and Duan Wenxi over.

"Wenxi, this book "Territory Governance Strategy" is now handed over to you." Wang Shuo handed the book to Duan Wenxi and patted his shoulder heavily.

"Thank you, Boss." Duan Wenxi looked happy.

"I called you guys here to discuss with you. During this trip, the magistrate of Changping County gave us 5 town hearts. What do you think we should do with them?"

Chang Gui turned his wooden head a few times and said to Wang Shuo: "Lord, I think this thing should be held in our hands. Later, we can build villages around Wana Town and consolidate our territory."

"Lord, this move may be inappropriate. In this way, we will lose our righteousness, and other lords will certainly be dissatisfied with us and isolated."

Wang Shuo also knew that these town hearts were hot potatoes. If he took them for himself, it would easily cause dissatisfaction among the lords of the Nanshan Association.

At that time, his prestige will surely plummet, and this news will definitely not be blocked.

Wang Shuo pondered for a while, and slowly said: "Why don't we also hold a competition and give the heart of the town to the winning lord?"

Duan Wenxi said with some concern: "Boss, in this way, no matter who wins, the remaining people will still be dissatisfied."

"Why not wait until the resurrection of the undead ends, and give it to whoever ranks higher?" Zou Yuanjie suggested, shaking his feather fan.

Wang Shuo thought about it and felt that this was reliable.

So he told the lords of Nanshan Society this news, and also told them that the higher the level of the territory, the more undead they would encounter, and the greater the defense pressure would be.

After doing all this, Wang Shuo has done his best!

As for whether other lords believe him or not, it will be clear at that time.

In the past few days, Wang Shuo has stepped up preparations for war. All the people in the production departments such as the blacksmith shop and the woodworking workshop are working overtime to produce materials.

The Chiyan Army is also fighting in the ancient battlefield, constantly improving their levels.

At the same time, other lords also frequently traded with Wana Town, all wanting to transform the potential of the territory into strength before the war.

Finally, the one-month deadline arrived.

[Warning: The Black Dragon King led the Black Dragon City's undead army and is about to attack. Please be prepared to resist. ]

[Warning:...]

...

After three consecutive system announcements, everyone became nervous.

Wang Shuo and others also looked solemn, standing on the city gate tower, and the military and civilians of Wana Town were ready.

Not long after, the undead army began to appear on the distant horizon.

"Prepare the catapult." Wang Shuo gave an order.

"Yes, Lord."

Li Jianguo responded.

Wana Town has currently manufactured 30 catapults. Li Jianguo placed the catapults inside the city wall, seven near each city gate, and one more at the north and south gates.

The four city gates have built urns. Although they are not large, they have greatly strengthened the defense of the city wall.

"Fire."

Thirty projectiles were thrown high, over the city wall, and hit the undead army two kilometers away.

Some undead with low health points were directly blown into powder.

But more undead only lost a little health points.

The undead didn't care and continued to rush towards the city gate and the city wall.

The one running in the front was a huge undead mammoth.

They were not just skeletons, but also covered with a layer of corroded skin all over their bodies. The skin was full of holes and was hollowed out, and one could even see through the holes and see through the whole body.

One thousand meters!

Five hundred meters!

Close.
